_provenance.fuente: Instagram @festivalfinca — 2 posts de selección oficial (26 y 27 jul 2026)
_provenance.metodo: lectura de las láminas del carrusel (título, traducción entre corchetes, director, país). El caption NO lista títulos.
_provenance.confianza: PROVISIONAL — un anuncio de IG no es fuente autoritativa. Re-verificar contra festivalfinca.com cuando publiquen la programación (al 28 jul la web solo tiene el texto de presentación).
_provenance.sin_datos_aun: duración, sinopsis, año, día, hora, sede, pósters de las obras
discrepancias_fuente: Cortometrajes: el caption dice «17 cortometrajes de 10 países», pero el carrusel solo muestra 16 (10 láminas: portada + 8 dobles + cierre). Falta 1 por identificar.
Documentales: el caption dice «9 documentales de Argentina, Brasil, Ecuador y Perú», pero el carrusel muestra 10, e incluye Uruguay y Polonia, que el caption no menciona.

_festival.organiza: IMD — Instituto Multimedia de Derechos Humanos
_festival.escala_anunciada: más de 35 películas; estrenos argentinos, latinoamericanos y mundiales; charlas y actividades especiales
_festival._keyArtOrigen: Póster oficial de la 8ª edición (post IG DbHJMF_D_OW, 22 jul 2026). Original 1081×1351 escalado a 480×600 sin recorte. Diseño de identidad visual acreditado en el caption del post.

sections._pendiente: Nombres y emojis de sección SIN curar — la doctrina exige objetos concretos del contenido real de cada sección, y eso requiere las sinopsis (que aún no existen) y aprobación de Juan.

films.title: Acid City
films.synopsis_en: A dystopian future that’s ever nearer, Acid City floats in toxic waters and is left to its own devices. But under the boiling sun, the city weaves together its own social fabric. With audio recordings taken off the streets of NYC, this animation offers us something rare in the face of climate catastrophe: hope.

films.title: El día que aprendí a volar
Ecocidio
films.synopsis: Un cortometraje animado con arcilla fresca sobre la historia del Ecocidiovista desde los ojos de la Pachamama. Ella es una anciana de barro que siente calor y no puede dormir, descubre que la temperatura global es muy elevada. Entristece al ver la cantidad de acciones naturalizadas que dañan al medio ambiente además de reconocer que el ser humano es incapaz de modificar su accionar.
films.synopsis_en: A short animated film made with fresh clay about the story of Ecocidiovista from the perspective of Pachamama. She is an elderly woman made of clay who feels hot and cannot sleep. She discovers that the global temperature is very high. She is saddened to see the number of normalized actions that harm the environment, as well as recognizing that humans are incapable of changing their behavior.

films.title: No als poalets
films.synopsis_en: In a small Spanish town, a local vote over a new recycling bin has divided the community. As opinions harden and tensions rise, the countdown to election day begins. The ballot boxes will reveal whether this intense polarization will prevail—and shape the town’s future.

films.title: Pozdravy z Rodosu
films.synopsis_en: What are you gonna do when the world’s on fire? Sit by the pool with a glass of Aperol Spritz and take a selfie for your friends back home? In this satirical take on tourism during the ecological crisis, Viera Čákanyová asks how costly the Ostrich Effect we all seem to suffer from really is? The film features realistic comments from holidaymakers, glossy travel agency advertisements and some dinosaurs, just passing by.

films.title: Sangre de plomo
films.synopsis: En un pueblo contaminado por una fábrica metalúrgica, una joven pareja resiste entre el abandono y la esperanza. Mientras esperan partir, una pérdida y una enfermedad amenazan con apagar la ilusión de un nuevo comienzo.  In a town poisoned by a toxic smelting plant, a young couple is caught between abandoning their home and hoping for their future. As they plan their departure, grief and illness strike.

films.title: Tuktuit: Caribou
films.synopsis_en: An Inuit mother and daughter, Kumaa’naaq and Marguerite, must negotiate the pressures of assimilation after relocating to a new life in the South in the 1930s. Based on a true story.

films.title: Ziki
films.synopsis_en: Ziki is a Congolese boy living in a village with his mother. One day, while the two are playing, Ziki discovers a mysterious tunnel winding beneath the kitchen floor. Curious, he decides to venture in, but as he walks, he slips and falls to the bottom of the tunnel. As he travels through it, he discovers a world built on exploitation and war in his homeland.

films.title: El amor duerme en la calle
films.synopsis_en: This documentary tells the story of people who, despite being homeless, are still looking for love. Cristina and Fabián live on the street. They met and what they felt was love at first sight. When their daughter was born, the baby was kept in the hospital because she had no home to take her to. Throughout the film, Cristina doesn't give up: we see her doubling her efforts to try to get her daughter back. Jonathan and Vanessa have been dating for years. Little by little, drugs have consumed their lives until they are left on the street. While they go through a spiral of aggression, they try to give up the addiction and give each other a second chance. Some time ago, Maria discovered that she has HIV. She decided not to tell Jonatan for fear that he would abandon her; when he found out about the disease, he decided to forgive her and continue their relationship. However, from that moment on, they both suffered conflicts and mistreatment.

films.title: Karuara, la gente del río
films.synopsis: Una valiente mujer indígena y su comunidad enfrentan poderosos intereses para salvar su río y el mundo que alberga. En una realidad donde la naturaleza tiene un precio, esta película nos recuerda nuestra conexión sagrada con el agua.
films.synopsis_en: Facing cultural genocide, a group of Indigenous women from Peru file a groundbreaking lawsuit demanding the government recognize the Marañón River, which flows into the Amazon, as a person with rights in order to protect the world of powerful spirits led by the Karuara (people of the river).

films.title: Pau d´Arco
films.synopsis_en: After surviving the massacre in which the police killed ten landless workers in Pará’s Amazon region, Fernando dos Santos becomes the only survivor to reveal his identity and testify. Still shaken, he recounts how the police murdered his boyfriend and tortured his companions, yet the film portrays him as far more than a victim: a courageous man who left the city’s comfort to chase the dream of owning land, using humor and intelligence to endure the solitude of being a gay man in rural Brazil. Alongside him is José Vargas, an idealistic lawyer defending the survivors and their right to justice. As he faces threats and isolation, the film exposes the human cost of truth, resilience, and the struggle for dignity in a land scarred by violence and inequality.

films.title: La vida fracturada
films.director: Cristian Cartier, Martin Longo, Pablo Piovano, Maximiliano Goldschmidt
films.synopsis_en: This documentary delves into the socio-environmental impacts of the fossil fuel industry and extractive activities in Vaca Muerta, Argentina, and how communities, especially the Mapuche people, are fighting to protect their territories. It is a call to action for environmental justice and a good life

films.title: Qué perforado está mi valle
films.director: Gastón Bejas, Natalia Gelós, Martín Alvarez Mullally, Nico Perrupato

films.title: Tierra que habla
films._nota: También en la selección de FICDEH 2026 — ahí ya tiene sinopsis, duración (82 min), año (2026) y ficha TMDB 1738957. Heredar cuando se enriquezca.
films.synopsis: Tres universos, tres cosmogonías. Solón, del pueblo Kankuamo de Colombia; Ailín, una mujer mapuche de la Patagonia; y Luciano, un biotecnólogo argentino, se unen en esta historia sobre la recuperación de la tierra y la lucha permanente entre indígenas y usurpadores. A pesar de la distancia, kankuamos y mapuches son dos pueblos unidos por las mismas circunstancias. ¿Quién puede reparar la tierra? ¿Quién la usurpa? ¿Quién la escucha?

films.title: Toroboro: el nombre de las plantas
films.synopsis_en: A botanical expedition in Ecuador's Amazon becomes a medium for an indigenous Huaorani community to remember the genocidal colonization it suffered in the 1960s. Meanwhile, a group of ecologists from the capital tries to stop oil exploitation in the last remaining forests where the isolated Huaoranis still live, who to this day refuse to come into contact with civilization.
